source.note: BCP supplies the checklist; TCDB is a manual structure and RC cross-check only. No TCDB data or images are automatically extracted.

decisions.variationHandling: Printer-code variants collapse to one card per printed number; BCP's duplicate #45 is removed. Error descriptions remain in Variant.
decisions.trueRookieHandling: Only the 28 unique printed numbers confirmed on the TCDB rookie index display RC.
decisions.exclusions: Pre-production sales and press promos, jumbo press proofs, and separately distributed members-only cards are not standard pack pulls.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: One equally weighted numbered checklist including six teamless checklist cards; all 28 verified rookie numbers are marked RC.
